rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something wonderful or enchanting.

example.english: The night view of this town is truly magical.
example.traditional: 呢個小鎮夜景真係好神奇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu2 zan3 je6 ging2 zan1 hai6 hou2 san4 kei4

rows.note: Use this for an especially dreamy, enchanting atmosphere or appearance.

example.english: The pool at this hotel looks magical at night.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店嘅泳池夜晚望落好夢幻。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 wing6 ci4 je6 maan5 mong6 lok6 hou2 mung6 waan6

rows.note: Use this when magical means involving or produced by actual magic.

example.traditional: 呢支魔法棒係有魔法嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 mo1 faat3 paang5 hai6 jau5 mo1 faat3 ge3
